patthana16.49:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na hetuceva na ahetukoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.49:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ sahetukañceva nacahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na ahetukoceva na nahetuca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika hetuhetusampayuttaduke nasanidassanattika nahetuhetusampayuttadukaṃ
